say:1:1623423001:1.text: Name's Bel. I'm with the newspaper too.
say:1:1623423001:1.source_cn: 我叫巴布，也是秘闻社的记者。

say:3:1623423003:1.text: Hey, no, not like that. I wasn't trying to sneak around. It's just... nobody talks about this stuff out loud anymore. Hearing it here, right now—it's rare.
say:3:1623423003:1.source_cn: 别误会，我并非有意偷听，只是二位讨论的议题，在当下的莱...

say:4:1623423004:1.text: Sure, the Lyceum's gotten more caught up in hype and quick wins. But not everyone wants to spend their life writing fluff.
say:4:1623423004:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的氛围确实比过去更浮躁，但也不是所有人都只甘心...

say:5:1623423005:1.text: Like me. I think news should do some good. It should push people toward better things and inspire them.
say:5:1623423005:1.source_cn: 比如……我认为新闻应该有正面意义，就是说，新闻需要引导...

say:6:1623423006:2.text: Bel doesn't brush Reeo off. If anything, he's somewhat agreeing with him. Reeo's frown softens a little.
say:6:1623423006:2.source_cn: 巴布的话没有直接否定雷欧，反而带着一丝认同，这让雷欧紧...

say:7:1623423007:1.text: To be honest, I respect what you did up there. Saying it straight to their faces takes guts. If it were me... I'm not sure I'd have done it.
say:7:1623423007:1.source_cn: 说实在的，我很佩服你刚才敢在台上直接说出来。换作是我，...

say:8:1623423008:1.text: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
say:8:1623423008:1.source_cn: 当然，也多亏了这位朋友及时出手。还没请教怎么称呼？
say:8:1623423008:1.male: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
say:8:1623423008:1.female: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?

choice_prompt:9:1623423008.text: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.source_cn: 当然，也多亏了这位朋友及时出手。还没请教怎么称呼？
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.male: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?
choice_prompt:9:1623423008.female: And yeah, you were lucky this friend of yours came to your rescue at the right moment. What should I call you?

say:10:1623423009:2.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?
say:10:1623423009:2.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?
say:10:1623423009:2.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Reeo... would it be okay if I joined you two?

say:11:1623423010:2.text: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
say:11:1623423010:2.source_cn: 雷欧沉默了片刻，似乎在权衡。最终，他看向你，似乎在询问...
say:11:1623423010:2.male: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
say:11:1623423010:2.female: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.

choice_prompt:12:1623423010.text: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.source_cn: 雷欧沉默了片刻，似乎在权衡。最终，他看向你，似乎在询问你的意见。
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.male: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.
choice_prompt:12:1623423010.female: Reeo goes quiet for a moment, weighing it. Then he looks at you, like he's asking what you think.

say:13:1623423011:1.text: Of course. I'm glad to have you with us.
say:13:1623423011:1.source_cn: 好，我很高兴有人加入我们。

say:14:1623423012:1.text: But just so we're clear, I'm not here for small talk. This isn't going to be a fun topic.
say:14:1623423012:1.source_cn: 不过我有话说在前面，我想聊的可不是什么轻松愉快的话题。

say:15:1623423013:1.text: You mean a piece about the magic contract, the speech loss cases, the students whose mana got damaged, right? I heard you on stage. That's a great angle!
say:15:1623423013:1.source_cn: 是关于“魔力契约”、“失语症”这些魔力受损者的观察报道...

say:16:1623423014:1.text: If you frame it around getting back up and finding hope again, that's exactly what this place needs right now.
say:16:1623423014:1.source_cn: 聚焦“振作”与“希望”，这正是迷茫中的莱希拉姆最需要的声音。

say:17:1623423015:1.text: If we work together, do the homework properly, talk to the right people, and package it in a way people will actually read, we might be able to move things in a better direction.
say:17:1623423015:1.source_cn: 如果我们能合作，用扎实的调查和……更易于被接受的方式，...

say:18:1623423016:1.text: At the end of the day, we all want the same thing. Something that helps the lost students see a way forward, right?
say:18:1623423016:1.source_cn: 说到底，我们都希望为那些迷茫的同学在黑暗里点一盏灯，对吧？

say:19:1623423017:1.text: Three heads are better than one. We'll have a broader perspective and make better judgments.
say:19:1623423017:1.source_cn: 三个人一起，视野总比一个人开阔，考虑问题也能更周全。

say:21:1623423019:1.text: Alright. Let's split up, talk to a few students who are in the thick of it, and see what's actually going on.
say:21:1623423019:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们可以先分头收集信息，采访几位有代表性的同...

say:22:1623423020:1.text: ... Okay. Let's team up. Just for now.

say:23:1623423021:1.text: Good. I'll go get things ready. See you soon.
say:23:1623423021:1.source_cn: 太好了。那我先走一步，去准备一下。回见。

say:25:1623423022:1.text: Bel excuses himself. As he walks away, Reeo lets out a long, barely perceptible sigh of relief.
say:25:1623423022:1.source_cn: 巴布礼貌地告辞离开。看着他的背影，雷欧长长地、不易察觉...

say:26:1623423023:1.text: Bel might have done most of the talking, but Reeo looks less cornered now, like a weight has finally been lifted off him. There's even a spark in his eyes, the kind you see when someone realizes they're not on their own anymore.
say:26:1623423023:1.source_cn: 尽管过程有些被主导，但比起之前的孤绝，他的眼神里明显重...

say:27:1623423024:1.text: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.
say:27:1623423024:1.source_cn: 巴布的性格比较强势……不过他说的有道理，这或许真是个机会。
say:27:1623423024:1.male: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.
say:27:1623423024:1.female: He's kinda pushy... but he's making sense. This might actually work out.

say:28:1623423025:1.text: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.
say:28:1623423025:1.source_cn: 我本来都快绝望了，没想到……还能遇到你们。感觉像做梦一...
say:28:1623423025:1.male: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.
say:28:1623423025:1.female: I was this close to giving up. Then you two showed up... It still feels a little unreal, like I'll blink and you'll be gone.

say:29:1623423026:1.text: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.
say:29:1623423026:1.source_cn: 那我们先分头行动，期待和你们下次碰面。
say:29:1623423026:1.male: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.
say:29:1623423026:1.female: Alright, let's split up for now. I'll see you both soon.
